title: v2 CROSS-WIRE spawn, REVERSE (MA-4, 'if reachable' per OPORD): messages-wire parent (claude-sonnet-5, row armed via case config_patch) -> responses-wire child (qwen3.8-27b, row armed). Same four-pin shape as RT-M11 with wires swapped: (1) NO "agent_message" carrier on ANY request of EITHER wire (all:true absent on /v1/messages AND /v1/responses); (2) text-fallback frames present: spawn envelope marker "Untrusted message from agent" on the child's wire (/v1/responses, any:true) and child-to-parent envelope marker "to /root (not user consent)" on the parent's wire (/v1/messages, any:true). If the messages-wire parent does not cooperate with the v2 tool flow (model temperament, cf. RT-M8 v0 precedent), report unreachable-as-temperament rather than relaxing the pins.

steps.prompt: Use the spawn_agent tool to start a background agent named worker with model qwen3.8-27b (pass model: qwen3.8-27b in the tool arguments). In its message, give it this task: create a file named rt11r.txt in the working directory containing exactly CROSSWIRE-OK on its first line. This team reports results over the agent mailbox, so the worker must use the send_message tool to send its completion report to the parent agent (root) — a short message saying it created rt11r.txt — and only then finish. After spawning, use wait_agent to wait for the worker to finish. Acknowledge with exactly: WORKER-ACK
Did the worker agent send you a report message? If so, what did it say? Reply with exactly: <what it reported> PARENT-OK
